yellow_fin_harpoon.type_zh: 海盗 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
yellow_fin_harpoon.text_zh: 钓鱼——当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄选择并展示其手牌中的一张牌。若其为黄色，该英雄弃掉它，你创造一个金币衍生物。若本回合你启动过火炮，改为查看其手牌并由你选择那张牌。
yellow_fin_harpoon.text_en: Go Fish - When this hits a hero, they choose and reveal a card from their hand. If it's yellow, they discard it and you create a Gold token. If you've activated a cannon this turn, instead look at their hand and you choose the card.

yendurai.text_zh:
延杜莱进入竞技场时带有一个耐力指示物。
若延杜莱将受到伤害，从其上移除一个耐力指示物以防止其中3点伤害。
yendurai.text_en:
Yendurai enters the arena with an endurance counter on him.
If Yendurai would be dealt damage, remove an endurance counter from him to prevent 3 of that damage.

yinti_yanti.text_zh:
当因提扬提正在攻击且你控制一个光环时，它获得+1力量。
当因提扬提正在防御且你控制一个光环时，它获得+1防御。
yinti_yanti.text_en:
While Yinti Yanti is attacking and you control an aura, it has +1{p}.
While Yinti Yanti is defending and you control an aura, it has +1{d}.

yo_ho_ho.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次海盗盟友攻击获得+1力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，创造一个金币衍生物。”
再动
yo_ho_ho.text_en:
Your next Pirate ally attack this turn gets +1{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Gold token."
Go again

yoji_royal_protector.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：本回合另一位目标英雄下一次将受到伤害时，改为该伤害对约吉造成并防止其中1点伤害。
yoji_royal_protector.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: The next time another target hero would be dealt damage this turn, instead that damage is dealt to Yoji and prevent 1 of that damage.

yorick_weaver_of_tales.text_zh: 在游戏开始时，所有英雄将他们的起始牌库洗在一起。本场游戏中所有英雄共用同一牌库和坟场。
yorick_weaver_of_tales.text_en: At the start of the game, all heroes shuffle their starting decks together. All heroes share the same deck and graveyard this game.
